newsitem.title: UK: Ashtenne scrapes to premium on LSE debut.
newsitem.headline: Ashtenne scrapes to premium on LSE debut.

text.p: Shares in property group Ashtenne Holdings Plc crept to a modest premium on Tuesday on their first day of dealings on the London Stock Exchange, dealers said.
Ashtenne shares, issued at 125p, rose just half a penny to 125-1/2p by 0857 GMT in thin volume of 21,000.
Dealers attributed the low turnover to investor caution ahead of the UK budget on July 2.
The property group specialises in the acquisition and management of industrial property estates in England, Scotland and Wales.
Ashtenne raised about 20 million stg via a placing and said the flotation would lift the company's profile whilst enabling it to access a wider capital market.
The group made pre-tax profits of 4.0 million stg for the year ended December 31, 1996 and had a gross rental income of 11.7 million stg for the period.
